prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for choose_path (layout, notification, redesign), adoption (new_flow, new_screen), finish hint, and home redesign due to having only single tests.
Home new_flow remains the only helpful kind of change with one winning test (interactive waiting room), though four other home new_flow tests showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen (3 tests), finish copy (2 tests), choose_path copy (2 tests), and sign_in copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Sign_in hints (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign (2 tests) produced no winning tests, showing no clear effect or negative impact.
Predictions were overall overly optimistic, consistently predicting larger gains than measured after noise correction.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet visibility verification screen: Add a new step new_pet_visibility_check after home_intro asking users to confirm their pet rendered on their screen. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not displaying on desktop, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting screen checklist status redesign: Switch the waiting screen layout to checklist format to display pet generation stages clearly as they complete. (why: Home step wait time has a high median (201s) and mean (2336s), causing drop-off during background rendering.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop control interaction exercise flow: Add an interactive tip carousel component on home_intro explaining right-clicking, dragging, and controlling the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control/hide/talk to the pet, and 4 reported desktop feature misbehavior.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path spotlight layout redesign: Redesign choose_path layout to spotlight format to focus attention on one companion path choice at a time. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration (514s) and a drop-off rate of 23.8%.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Sign-in simplified card layout: Change sign_in screen to a simple card layout with direct primary sign-in action to prevent app stalling. (why: 2 support emails noted sign-in screen missing or stalling, and sign_in conversion is 72.9%.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen status estimation notice: Show dynamic completion time estimate and tip delay on waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Waiting stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to user drop-off before home_intro.)
6: [finish, copy] Home intro controls guide copy: Update home_intro body copy with concise instructions on where to find the pet on the desktop and system tray. (why: Support received 3 emails on unclear pet controls and 3 on pets not appearing on desktop; finish conversion is 64.8%.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Story screen quick setup callout copy: Update story screen headline and body copy to emphasize quick start choices and fast companion setup. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a mean duration of 514s.)
